answer: A sybil swarm drowns when each trader must hold a reef-diver echo log. First, it posts a 120-token bond and logs ten supervised dives, each countersigned by a different diver. Second, every deal leaves an echo entry of price, partner, and result, and mismatched echoes flag the account. Third, limits rise only after forty honest days, while cheating forfeits the bond and bans the diver for 180 days. Forging one identity costs about $1,180; 1,000 cost $1,180,000 and 10,000 supervised hours. Like a pearl that only forms inside a real oyster in a wide ocean, trust must grow, not be printed.
